✨ just-the-browser | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: To strip down popular web browsers to their core functionality, removing distractions and privacy concerns for a cleaner, more focused user experience.
✨ Key Features: • Removes AI features, telemetry, sponsored content, and product integrations from web browsers. • Utilizes hidden enterprise settings for a streamlined experience.
📖 Summary: Just the Browser is a project that streamlines desktop web browsers by removing unwanted features like AI integrations, telemetry, and sponsored content. It aims to provide a clean, focused browsing experience using hidden enterprise settings and offers easy installation scripts and manual configuration guides for popular browsers.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 fluidd | Vue
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing a user-friendly web interface to control and monitor Klipper-powered 3D printers.
✨ Key Features: • Responsive UI (desktop, tablet, mobile) • Customizable layouts • Built-in color themes • Manage multiple printers • Easy installation via KIAUH
📖 Summary: Fluidd is a free and open-source web interface designed for Klipper, a 3D printer firmware. It provides a responsive and customizable user interface for managing multiple 3D printers from various devices.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 flowsint | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Visualizing and exploring relationships in Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) data for cybersecurity investigations.
✨ Key Features: • Graph exploration tool • OSINT focused • Ethical investigation • Transparency and verification • Visual, flexible, and extensible
📖 Summary: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification. It provides a modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations, primarily for cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 free-for-dev | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To help developers and DevOps practitioners discover and utilize free tiers of various cloud services and software offerings relevant to infrastructure development.
✨ Key Features: • Curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings • Focus on services useful for infrastructure developers (DevOps, SysAdmins)
📖 Summary: This repository is a curated list of Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) offerings that provide free tiers. It specifically targets infrastructure developers, DevOps practitioners, and system administrators, helping them discover valuable free resources for their work.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 CasaOS | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly interface for managing a personal cloud server, enabling easy deployment and management of self-hosted applications and services.
✨ Key Features: • Simple and elegant UI • Easy App Installation • Docker support • Open Source • Supports various hardware
📖 Summary: CasaOS is an open-source personal cloud operating system designed for ease of use and elegance. It simplifies the management of self-hosted applications and services, allowing users to easily deploy and manage Docker containers for a personalized home cloud experience.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
